tagline: Creating mobility solutions that people enjoy riding, and lead societies to a low carbon future
hero_kpi_rationale: The order backlog is Alstom's primary indicator of future growth, reflecting sustained demand in rail infrastructure and mobility systems, despite the absence of technological wow factors such as AI or cloud.

kpis.name: Order backlog
kpis.explanation: Total value of new orders signed by Alstom during the year.
kpis.description: Orders reached €18.9 billion in 2023/24, up 14%, driven by major contracts in Europe and India.
kpis.signal: Strong backlog growth, supported by European and Asian markets.

kpis.name: Sales
kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated from the sale of products and services.
kpis.description: Sales amounted to €17.6 billion in 2023/24, an increase of 7% compared to the previous year.
kpis.signal: Steady revenue growth, aligned with the delivery of ongoing projects.

kpis.name: Adjusted EBIT margin
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit relative to sales.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBIT margin improved to 5.7% in 2023/24, compared to 5.2% the previous year, due to efficiency gains.
kpis.signal: Improved operating margin driven by better project execution.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.description: FCF was negative at -€557 million in 2023/24, impacted by outflows related to large-scale projects.
kpis.signal: Negative cash flow due to investment in ongoing projects.

risks.title: Dependence on Bombardier Transportation integration
risks.score_rationale: Major risk mentioned from the outset (doubling in size since 2021). Intense language: 'journey to first integrate, then stabilise and now transform'. Central to strategy. High weight: 2021 acquisition remains in operational integration and stabilization phase.

risks.title: Supply chain risks and supplier dependencies
risks.score_rationale: Implied by complex global structure (254 sites, 64 countries, 7 JVs in China). Moderate language but critical context: 'smooth and uninterrupted supply' highlighted as a key challenge. Bombardier adds new dependencies (bogies from Germany, monorails from Canada). Trend: amplified by integration.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and integrity of rail systems
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly mentioned: 'protect the integrity and security of rail systems against digital vulnerabilities'. Direct and business-specific language. Positioned in R&D strategy (€549M dedicated). High criticality: signaling and control systems impact public safety.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and environmental standards
risks.score_rationale: Major structural risk: 60% of sales aligned with EU taxonomy, SBTi targets validated, 87% of solutions eco-designed. Strong language on ESG commitment (DJSI, CDP score A). Increasing regulation of emissions (Scope 1/2/3). Category weight: determines access to public markets.

risks.title: Intellectual property and forced technology transfer
risks.score_rationale: Implicit but critical: 7 unconsolidated JVs in China, 11 JVs for rolling stock/signalling/services. Language: 'most active foreign railway manufacturer in China'. Structural risk of involuntary technology transfer. Weight: China represents a major strategic market.

risks.title: Intense competition and margin pressure
risks.score_rationale: Adjusted EBIT margin at 5.7% (down from 5.2% the previous year). Language: 'difficult year', operational efficiency plan launched. Position: market leader but under pressure. Trend: deterioration acknowledged, requiring transformation plan.

risks.title: Operational execution and management of complex projects
risks.score_rationale: Explicit language: 'difficult year', 'comprehensive operational, commercial, and cost efficiency plan'. Negative FCF (-€557M), backlog of €91.9B (execution critical). Position: central to transformation. Trend: improvement underway (+12% production) but fragile.

risks.title: Interest rate volatility and debt refinancing
risks.score_rationale: Moody's rating Baa3 with negative outlook (confirmed May 2024). Language: 'maintain solid and sustainable Investment Grade rating'. Debt reduction plan of €2B by March 2025. Weight: refinancing critical to fund backlog and Bombardier integration.

ai_positioning.summary: Alstom adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, progressively integrating digital tools into its signalling systems and predictive maintenance, without making it a major strategic lever.
evidence: Development of digital solutions such as intelligent signalling systems
Targeted R&D investments in sustainable innovation
